title: Run the method reports as advisory hooks for the method kit
summary: The bundled inventarch/ia-method-kit is now 0.9.0, and the public kits package is 1.0.6. The kit ships onwrite.json and handlers.json, which run one new script of the core, scripts/method-advise.mjs, after a write to a .ia record, after a Bash or PowerShell call and at a resumed or compacted session. It reports the ceiling and the exit evidence of the tasks in the changed or uncommitted records (at most 2 from a written file, 3 per call), says how many tasks it evaluated and how many it did not, prints anything it could not evaluate as not evaluated and never as clear, never downloads a CLI, and blocks nothing. It is not a complete check: the full report, scripts/method-gate.mjs, is. A handlers.json run may now be exactly ${PLUGIN}/scripts/method-advise.mjs, an allowlist of that one script, accepted on session and tool post handlers only, run only for a trusted kit inside an IA workspace. The ia-method contract is 0.2.0 with REQ-METHOD-02, the exit evidence of closed tasks. A core older than this release skips the kit's handlers.json with a reason, and its onwrite.json command finds no script and reports nothing; upgrade the plugin with the kit. The method gate script is unchanged; ceiling.mjs now honours IA_CORE_METHOD_READ_TIMEOUT_MS as exit-evidence.mjs does.
